item.title: DOLLY | by Bianca Gingham Button-Up Top Puff Sleeves & Square Neck Checkered
item.description:
Add a touch of timeless charm to your everyday wardrobe with DOLLY by Bianca! Featuring a classic gingham checkered pattern, an elegant square neckline, and feminine puff sleeves, this top combines a sweet, Korean-inspired aesthetic with effortless everyday comfort.

Designed with a flattering gathered waist and a flowy silhouette, DOLLY gives your outfit a soft, feminine look without compromising comfort. Its button-up front adds a classic touch, making it easy to style for casual outings, coffee dates, shopping trips, and everyday wear.

Pair it with jeans, tailored trousers, or your favorite skirt for a chic and effortlessly polished outfit.


PRODUCT HIGHLIGHTS
Classic Gingham Pattern – A timeless checkered design that adds a cute, stylish touch to your outfit.
Elegant Square Neckline – Creates a flattering neckline with a feminine, modern appeal.
Puffed Short Sleeves – Adds volume and a soft, romantic silhouette.
Button-Up Front – Features functional styling details for a classic blouse look.
Gathered Waist Design – Creates a relaxed, flowy silhouette for an effortlessly feminine appearance.
Comfortable Loose Fit – Designed for ease of movement and comfortable everyday wear.
Versatile Styling – Easy to pair with jeans, shorts, trousers, or skirts.


PRODUCT DETAILS
Material: Seersucker Fabric
